name: ai-launchpad
description: Back-office help for an Estonian small business, inside the assistant you already use. It looks up public company facts, lists deadlines, and walks you through linking accounting, e-mail or your bank. You sign in yourself. Nothing is sent, paid or filed until you approve that exact content.
